name: Warm Copper Kitchen
style: photoreal cinematic macro food photography, warm side light, natural textures, restrained camera movement
set: One warm kitchen: cream stone counter, dark walnut board, copper skillet rear left, small brass bowl right, parchment-lined dark tray, brushed steel knife, one pair of natural-nailed adult hands; same window light and oven in every shot
continuity: Keep surfaces, tool placement, hands, light direction and food count fixed. Show food moving through prep, heat, assembly and service in the same kitchen. Do not introduce a new wall, table, glove or chef between shots.
